'''v1.30.0''' is the eighty-third update to be released in Tower Defense Simulator, on the 4th of September 2024. It added two skins, the {{ Color |Other|Mako}} [[DJ Booth]] and the {{ Color |Other|Plushie}} [[Cowboy]]. This update encompassed three versions, the main v1.30.0 update (released 4 September 2024) and two minor updates, the v1.30.1 update (released 4 September 2024) and v1.30.2 (released 11 September 2024).
